summary: Diane Papan (CA Assembly D21) received $2,000 in direct Israel-lobby contributions: $1,500 from AIPAC/Birthright donor John Fisher (2023) and $500 from UC Regent Richard Leib (2021).
CalMatters lists Diane Papan as recorded Aye on AB 715 (Assembly Floor). The bill creates an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight; its text does not explicitly name IHRA.
